steps.caption: Business photos & videos
steps.narration: Business photos and videos are the ones you posted to the listing yourself.

steps.caption: Customer photos & videos
steps.narration: Customer photos and videos are the ones customers added, counted on their own.

youtube.title: How to see the photos on your Google listing | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: The Photos & Videos tab of a linked location in ConstructHUB: the photos you posted and the ones customers added, counted separately and synced from the listing along with reviews and performance. Click a photo to open it on Google; new ones go up through Posts & Photos.
